## R12. Self hosting Excalidraw - Umbrella issue

because: [Q-0401, Q-0344, Q-0556, Q-0181]  # 4 customers · 3 segments · 141 upvotes · last seen 21 days ago
metric: TODO: how will you know this worked?
opportunity: O-65 · Host · score 29.7

> "Self hosting Excalidraw - Umbrella issue" — Q-0401 · issue · contributor · 2026-11-04

> "What is the process of hosting this in server as I need to do changes and host it but i am getting cors error in collab-server api i have changed in vite_app_ws as well still getting this and also getting unable to import dynamic in server, local is working fine." — Q-0344 · issue · user · 2024-01-20

> "As a result of not differentiating it from other state right now, we have a race condition where if the host app (or the editor) sets an error before initial scene is finished loading, it gets overwritten — either by our `defaultAppState` on init, or by host app overwriting it if they restore whatever they persist to DB into a fully-qualified AppState." — Q-0556 · issue · maintainer · 2023-01-01
